data.one_liner: Customizable searchable single or multiple choice dropdown widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to search through single or multiple choice lists inside a dialog box or menu. It supports pagination, future/network/API searches, sorting, and filtering.
use_when: You need a dropdown or picker that allows searching through a large list of items.
You require single or multiple selection support with custom filters, sorting, or pagination.
You need asynchronous/future-based data loading for dropdown choices.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, standard non-searchable dropdown menu.
You require complex form validation frameworks beyond standard FormField validation.
strengths: Highly customizable UI and dialog layout.
Supports future/API searches, pagination, and custom filters/sorting.
Handles both single and multiple selection modes.
weaknesses: Large API surface with many optional parameters which can increase complexity.
Documentation for advanced use cases primarily relies on example projects.
data.minimal_example:
SearchChoices.single(
  items: [
    DropdownMenuItem(
      child: Text("Item 1"),
      value: 1,
    ),
    DropdownMenuItem(
      child: Text("Item 2"),
      value: 2,
    ),
  ],
  value: 1,
  hint: "Select one",
  searchHint: "Search",
  onChanged: (value) {},
  isExpanded: true,
)
